description: Test remaining aligned operand-position row ties by checkpoint distance
proposal: Family: position representation. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 9 prior macro-attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0030 at 2,128 parameters/99.14%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0131, whose first-column operand-position tie scored 15.91% at 1,656 parameters. Hypothesis: operand-role identity may be critical at the least-significant carry origin but redundant in a later column. The helper excludes measured rows 1/2, orders the nine remaining aligned operand row pairs by current L2 distance, ties one full 16D pair per micro-trial, and uses only official runner acceptance/rollback. Stop at first scored discard or error, no pair, nine micro-trials, or 14 wall-clock minutes. This is more informative than selecting the next numeric column because checkpoint distance gives the least disruptive remaining categorical test.
summary: The distance-ordered operand-row policy tested positions 19/20, the nearest remaining aligned pair (L2 distance 0.007489). The 1,659-parameter candidate scored 98.44% and was discarded. Outcomes: 0 accepts, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors; frontier remained 1,672/99.01%. Compute used one checkpoint migration and official verification in about 1m22s. Stop reason: first scored discard before the 9-trial/14-minute cap, showing even the closest remaining operand-role pair is sensitive.
